summary_md: **VinciEye ([@vincieye](https://x.com/vincieye/status/2116334893458157840))** shares NVIDIA's *LucidLyra* ([arXiv 2610.40495](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40495v1), [project](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/lucidlyra)). It distills video diffusion into feed-forward 3D Gaussians from a single view that also answer open-vocabulary queries without fine-tuning.
